# MCP tool specification

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:tools` from the registered tool schemas. Do not edit by hand. -->

Server: `freshdesk-connector` v0.1.0 · transports: stdio, Streamable HTTP (`POST /mcp`) · all tools are read-only.

Every successful result carries the payload twice: as `structuredContent` (validated against the output
schema below) and as pretty-printed JSON text. Failures return `isError: true` with
`{"error": {"type": "...", "message": "...", "retry_after_seconds"?: n}}`, where `type` is one of
`ValidationError`, `AuthError`, `PermissionError`, `NotFoundError`, `RateLimitedError`, `UpstreamError`, `InternalError`.

| Tool | Title |
|---|---|
| [`get_contact`](#get_contact) | Get contact |
| [`get_ticket`](#get_ticket) | Get ticket |
| [`list_ticket_conversations`](#list_ticket_conversations) | List ticket conversations |
| [`list_tickets`](#list_tickets) | List tickets |
| [`search_contacts`](#search_contacts) | Search contacts |
| [`search_tickets`](#search_tickets) | Search tickets |

## `get_contact`

Get a customer contact by id (e.g. a ticket's requester_id): name, email, phone, company, job title, tags and status.

**Annotations:** `readOnlyHint: true`, `destructiveHint: false`, `idempotentHint: true`, `openWorldHint: true`

**Example call**

```json
{
  "name": "get_contact",
  "arguments": {
    "contact_id": 5001
  }
}
```

<details><summary>Input schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "contact_id": {
      "type": "integer",
      "exclusiveMinimum": 0,
      "maximum": 9007199254740991,
      "description": "Freshdesk contact id"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "contact_id"
  ],
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"
}
```

</details>

## `get_ticket`

Get one ticket by id: subject, status, priority, tags, assignment, due date, plain-text description, requester contact details and custom fields. Use list_ticket_conversations for the reply/note thread.

**Annotations:** `readOnlyHint: true`, `destructiveHint: false`, `idempotentHint: true`, `openWorldHint: true`

**Example call**

```json
{
  "name": "get_ticket",
  "arguments": {
    "ticket_id": 101
  }
}
```

<details><summary>Input schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "ticket_id": {
      "type": "integer",
      "exclusiveMinimum": 0,
      "maximum": 9007199254740991,
      "description": "Freshdesk ticket id"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "ticket_id"

  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"
}
```

## `list_ticket_conversations`

List the conversation thread of a ticket, oldest first: customer replies (direction=incoming), agent replies and internal notes (kind=note, private=true are agent-only). Bodies are plain text, truncated at 4000 characters.

**Annotations:** `readOnlyHint: true`, `destructiveHint: false`, `idempotentHint: true`, `openWorldHint: true`

**Example call**

```json
{
  "name": "list_ticket_conversations",
  "arguments": {
    "ticket_id": 101
  }
}
```

<details><summary>Input schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "ticket_id": {
      "type": "integer",
      "exclusiveMinimum": 0,
      "maximum": 9007199254740991,
      "description": "Freshdesk ticket id"
    },
    "page": {
      "description": "Page number, starting at 1",
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 9007199254740991
    },
    "per_page": {
      "description": "Results per page, 1–100 (default 10)",
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 100
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "ticket_id"
  ],
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"
}
```

</details>

## `list_tickets`

List Freshdesk tickets, most recently created first. Without updated_since Freshdesk only returns tickets created in the last 30 days. Filter by requester email, company or a predefined view; for status, priority, tag or date-range filters use search_tickets instead.

**Annotations:** `readOnlyHint: true`, `destructiveHint: false`, `idempotentHint: true`, `openWorldHint: true`

**Example call**

```json
{
  "name": "list_tickets",
  "arguments": {
    "requester_email": "priya.nair@example.com",
    "updated_since": "2026-09-01",
    "per_page": 10
  }
}
```

<details><summary>Input schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "filter": {
      "description": "Predefined Freshdesk view (relative to the API key's agent)",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "new_and_my_open",
        "watching",
        "spam",
        "deleted"
      ]
    },
    "requester_email": {
      "description": "Only tickets raised by this email address",
      "type": "string",
      "format": "email",
      "pattern": "^(?:[A-Za-z0-9_'+\\-]+\\.)*[A-Za-z0-9_'+\\-]*[A-Za-z0-9_+-]@(?:[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9\\-]*\\.)+[A-Za-z]{2,}$"
    },
    "company_id": {
      "description": "Only tickets from this company",
      "type": "integer",
      "exclusiveMinimum": 0,
      "maximum": 9007199254740991
    },
    "updated_since": {
      "description": "Only tickets updated at or after this ISO 8601 date/time; also lifts the 30-day default window",
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date",
          "pattern": "^(?:(?:\\d\\d[2468][048]|\\d\\d[13579][26]|\\d\\d0[48]|[02468][048]00|[13579][26]00)-02-29|\\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|30)|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]|1\\d|2[0-8])))$"
        },
        {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time",
          "pattern": "^(?:(?:\\d\\d[2468][048]|\\d\\d[13579][26]|\\d\\d0[48]|[02468][048]00|[13579][26]00)-02-29|\\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|30)|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]|1\\d|2[0-8])))T(?:(?:[01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d:[0-5]\\d(?:\\.\\d+)?(?:Z|([+-](?:[01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d)))$"
        }
      ]
    },
    "order_by": {
      "description": "Sort field (default created_at)",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "created_at",
        "due_by",
        "updated_at",
        "status"
      ]
    },
    "order_type": {
      "description": "Sort direction (default desc)",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "asc",
        "desc"
      ]
    },
    "page": {
      "description": "Page number, starting at 1",
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 300
    },
    "per_page": {
      "description": "Results per page, 1–100 (default 30)",
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 100
    }
  },
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"
}
```

</details>

## `search_contacts`

Find customer contacts by exact email, exact phone, company id or creation date (criteria are AND-ed; at least one is required). Freshdesk's search does not support fuzzy name matching. 30 results per page, max 10 pages.

**Annotations:** `readOnlyHint: true`, `destructiveHint: false`, `idempotentHint: true`, `openWorldHint: true`

**Example call**

```json
{
  "name": "search_contacts",
  "arguments": {
    "email": "priya.nair@example.com"
  }
}
```

<details><summary>Input schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "email": {
      "description": "Exact email address",
      "type": "string",
      "format": "email",
      "pattern": "^(?:[A-Za-z0-9_'+\\-]+\\.)*[A-Za-z0-9_'+\\-]*[A-Za-z0-9_+-]@(?:[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9\\-]*\\.)+[A-Za-z]{2,}$"
    },
    "phone": {
      "description": "Exact phone number as stored in Freshdesk",
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 3,
```

## `search_tickets`

Search tickets by status, priority, tag, group, assigned agent and created/updated date ranges. Values of one field are OR-ed, different fields are AND-ed; at least one criterion is required. Freshdesk returns 30 results per page and at most 10 pages (300 results); 'total' tells you how many matched. Newly created tickets can take a short while to become searchable.

**Annotations:** `readOnlyHint: true`, `destructiveHint: false`, `idempotentHint: true`, `openWorldHint: true`

**Example call**

```json
{
  "name": "search_tickets",
  "arguments": {
    "status": [
      "Open",
      "Pending"
    ],
    "priority": [
      "Urgent"
    ],
    "created_after": "2026-09-01"
  }
}
```
